description:
Hushfacebook v0.21.0 targets Facebook 585.0.0.47.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This one has 117 patches and stays on Facebook 585.0.0.47.54 and Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, so just update the patches and repatch. The Hush settings got a new look with a `Switches that are on` list and a Custom accent color, and they come in Russian now. New switches put a post's photos in a carousel, turn Reels gray, start a break after 20 reels, translate or hide posts in other languages, and add a seek bar and a full player button to feed videos. Fixes cover comments that stopped loading after the first ten and Back from a post jumping the feed to the top.

Validation: 79 runtime tests passed locally. All 1379 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 117 patches applied to Facebook 585.0.0.47.54, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 585.0.0.47.54, build 476015655, or its 32-bit build 476015543. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Added

* New `Open full screen videos centered` under Video and audio. A video you open in Facebook's full screen player, from a comment or a link, starts with its details and comments folded away, so a wide video sits in the middle of the screen instead of up at the top. The arrow under it still opens the panel. It's off by default. (#242)
* New `Dim around a zoom` under `Pinch to zoom`. Turn it off and the rest of the screen stays as it is while you zoom into a photo or story, instead of going dark behind it. It's on by default, so zooms look the same as before until you change it. (#220)
* New `Keep videos playing while zoomed` under `Pinch to zoom`. A video you zoom into on a profile or Page keeps playing under your fingers, where it used to stop on the frame it showed. With `Stay zoomed` on too, press and hold the zoom to pause the video and hold again to play it. Stories still hold still while you zoom. It's off by default. (#220)
* New `Search photo in post menus`, right under `Save photo in post menus`. A post with one photo gets Search photo in its three-dot menu, and a tap hands that photo to the app you pick, like Google Lens, so you can find out what's in it or copy the text out of it. The photo comes from Facebook's servers at the biggest size the post has, and only the app you pick can read it. It's off by default and needs `Save any photo` on. (#245, #248)
* New `Show Reels in gray` under Reels and Watch, with the other `Clean up Reels` switches. The Reels screen shows in black and white, buttons, caption and video alike, which makes it a little easier to put down. Your feed, stories, photos and chats keep their colors, and so does a reel you download. A video you open full screen from the feed can go gray too, since it plays on a screen like Reels. A swipe between reels doesn't flash color, and the colors come back when you leave Reels. It starts from the next reel after you turn it on, because the reel's player has to draw with the rest of the screen for its video to go gray, so this needs the `Turn off HDR brightness` patch in your build too. It's off by default and costs a little battery on Reels.
* New `Also after 20 reels` under `Take breaks`. With it on, a break also starts once you've watched 20 different reels, if that comes before your `Break after` time. A reel counts after it's played for 3 seconds, so ones you swipe past right away don't, and watching the same reel again doesn't count twice. Ads and live videos never count. The count starts over after a break, after time away as long as a break, and when the switch is turned off, and it survives a restart of Facebook. It's off by default and needs the `Resume long videos` patch, which is what notices reels playing. (#248)
* New `Full player button on feed videos` under Video and audio, right below `Inline feed video controls`. It puts a button next to play that opens the video in Facebook's own full player with all its controls, and a video playing in the feed stops first. Live videos get it too. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs `Inline feed video controls` on as well. (#239)
* New `Clean up the story viewer` under Stories, with three switches. `Hide song and effect credits` takes the song or effect credit off the line under the poster's name. A line that only showed the credit goes away, and one that switched back and forth keeps just its usual text. A story Facebook labels Trending or Suggested keeps its line as it was, so the label isn't lost. `Hide reply suggestions` takes away the row of suggested replies at the bottom of a story, and the reply box stays. `Progress bar at the bottom` draws a thin bar along the bottom of a story that fills as it plays, like the one on Reels. All three start off, and the first two apply from the next story you open. (#380)
* New `Story viewer taps` under Stories, with two switches. `Story play button` puts a play and pause button on a story when you tap its middle, the way Reels does. It fades away a couple of seconds after the story plays again, and taps on the sides still change stories. `Double tap for next story` makes stories change only on a double tap (the left side goes back, anywhere else goes forward), so a single tap pauses or plays the story instead, or brings up the button when that's on. The pause is Facebook's own. Both start off. (#380)
* New `Block button on reaction lists` under Comments and writing, next to `Block button on comments`. In the list of people who reacted to a post, the button at the end of each row (Add friend, Message, Confirm and the like) says Block, and a tap opens Facebook's own block screen for that person, with its usual question before anything is blocked. Your own row and rows Facebook shows no button on stay as they are. It's off by default, and a change shows on lists opened after it. (#271)
* New `GmsCore support` patch for phones without Google Play services, so Facebook gets its push notifications through microG-RE. It's off by default and only shows in Expert mode, since on a phone with Google Play services Facebook would stop getting push.
* New `Open in Facebook from the share menu` patch. Messenger keeps facebook.com links in its own browser, so share the page from there (or the link from any app) and pick Open in Facebook, and it opens in the patched Facebook. Hushfacebook settings lists it under Built-in changes, with a line on how to use it. (#111)
* New `Let each post come back once` under `Hide posts you've already seen`. A post counts as seen after a quarter second on screen, so a quick scroll used to hide plenty you never read. With this on, a post you scrolled past shows up one more time, and it's hidden once you scroll past it again. It starts off. (#186)
* Hushfacebook now tells you when Facebook's icons look soft because of the download you patched. The 32-bit bundle only has images for 320 dpi screens, so on a sharper screen the Home, bell, Profile, Search and Messenger icons get enlarged and look blurry. On a phone that can run the 64-bit bundle, a short note says so once after you install, and a line under the status card in the settings names the bundle to patch instead. (#365)
* New `Hide Up next on videos` under Reels and Watch. It takes the UP NEXT bar, with the next video's name and length, off the bottom of a video you open from the feed. Off by default. (#367)
* `Show the post date on reels` now dates older reels too. Past the first week Facebook often leaves the date out, so an older reel showed nothing under the poster's name even with the switch on. It now reads "3 weeks ago" there. A new `Show the post date as` list right under it picks between how long ago and the date it was posted, like Oct 12. (#357)
* New `Hide pictures on the Blocked list` under Privacy. The people on Facebook's Blocking page, in Settings & privacy, show without their profile pictures, and their names and Unblock buttons stay put. Every build has it, and it starts off. (#361)
* New `Videos in search results wait for a tap` under Video and audio. Videos in search results stay still until you tap one, whether `Tap to play` is on or off. It's off until you turn it on. (#363)
* New `Hide the Reels title` under Reels and Watch. It takes the word Reels off the top of the Reels tab and leaves the buttons beside it. It starts off. (#362)
* New `Hide the Join button on posts` under News feed. A post from a group you haven't joined shows a Join button after the group's name, and this takes it off while the name stays. It also takes the Join group bar off the bottom of those groups' videos. It shows on posts drawn after you flip it. It starts off. (#356)
* New `Emoji after the logo` text setting under Appearance, next to `Home header text`. Type an emoji and it's drawn right after the Facebook logo at the top of Home, as tall as the logo and in its own colors, so `Badge and logo colors` and the accent don't tint it. It also follows your header text or picture when you use one. Leave it blank for none, and restart Facebook to see a change. A settings file now carries the emoji too. (#360)
* New `Switches that are on` row at the top of the settings, above the first section, and search finds it too. It opens a list of only the switches you have on, each with its working switch. Turn one off there and it's off everywhere. (#353)
* `Accent color` has a new Custom choice. Pick it and a small editor opens with red, green and blue sliders, a preview swatch and a color code field, all kept in step. Save keeps the color, and a restart applies it. A settings file now carries the color, so importing it elsewhere keeps your Custom accent. (#355)
* New `Remove the gap above Marketplace listings` under Marketplace. On some phones, like Pixels on Android 17, a listing opened with an empty band between the status bar and its close and share buttons. That band is gone now, and phones that never had it look the same. It's on by default. (#333)
* New `Restore feed sound after opened videos` under Video and audio. A video you open from the feed still plays with its sound, but once you go back the feed's sound is what it was before, even after a long watch. Before, watching a while with sound left every feed video playing out loud. Works with `Keep feed videos muted` on or off, and it starts off. (#350)
* New `Only reels from accounts I follow` switch under Reels and Watch, part of `Clean up Reels`. The Reels tab then keeps reels from people and Pages you follow and skips the ones Facebook would show a Follow button on. The first reel it opens on always stays. If Facebook keeps sending only reels from people you don't follow, a message says so and those reels stop being filtered for now, since Facebook ends the tab on an error otherwise. It can take a little longer to fill, and it starts off. (#349)
* New `Photo carousel` under News feed. A post with several photos or videos shows them in a row you swipe through, one at a time, instead of Facebook's grid. A count like 4/10 sits in the corner and dots under the photo show where you are. Posts with sensitive photos keep their cover. It starts off. (#345)
* New `Hide posts in other languages` under News feed, part of `Hide posts by words`. It hides a post when your phone is sure its words are in a language you don't keep, and a reel on the Reels tab when its caption is. Pick them in `Languages to keep`. With none picked, your phone's own language stays. Posts and reels that are too short to tell, have no caption, or that the phone isn't sure about stay too, and nothing leaves the phone. It starts off. (#382)
* New `Hide the line over the comment box` under Comments and writing. The thin line along the top of the comment box you get when you open a post goes away. Off by default. (#344)
* New `Rounded tab bar` under Appearance, in Screen and motion. With the tab bar at the bottom it turns into a pill with round ends, a bit narrower and lifted just off the bottom of the screen. Works with `See-through bars` too, and it starts off. (#344)
* Search results get their Posts chip back, right after Reels, so you can see only posts for what you searched. It's on by default, and `Show Posts in search` under Search turns it off. (#339)
* New `Seek bar on feed videos` under Video and audio. It runs a bar just above the bottom of a feed video, clear of the speaker and tagged people buttons, and you drag it and let go to jump to that point, with the time showing while you drag. It starts off, and with `Tap to play` on it needs `Inline feed video controls` on too. (#326)
* New `Hide replies button` switch under Comments and writing. A reply thread you opened gets a Hide replies button over it, with the arrow pointing up, so you can close it again after reading. It's off by default. (#325)
* New `Hide the Back reminder` switch under News feed. With `Back leaves Home where it is` on, Back keeps your place without the "Press Back again to go to the top" toast. (#334)
* New `Hide the Commission eligible label` switch under News feed takes that label off reels, along with the gap it leaves under the creator's name when a reel has nothing else to disclose. It starts off. (#329)
* New `Hide the 2x popups` switch under Video and audio. Holding a video for 2x then shows no pill at all, so no "Speed: 2x", "Release to lock" or "Locked at 2x speed", in your feed as well as on reels. The hold and the lock still work. It starts off. (#289, #343)
* New `Move the speaker above the three dots` switch under Video and audio. It puts a reel's speaker button in the side column, right above the three dots. You'll find it off at first. (#331)
* The Hush settings now come in Russian, translated by vortexnode. (#335)
* Posts in another language can get a Translate line under their text, or show translated by themselves with See original under them, through Google Translate. Both switches start off, in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, where you also pick the language to translate to and the languages to leave alone. (#332)
* New `Tab order` row under Tabs and navigation, next to the Hide tabs switches. Tap a tab in its list to move it up, then save and restart Facebook. Facebook opens on whichever tab you put first, unless `Open on a chosen tab` says otherwise. The order goes in settings backups too. (#341)
* New `Show only watched stories` switch under Stories. The Stories tray then keeps only the stories you've already watched, so you can find one again, and you turn it off to get the new ones back. `Hide seen stories` waits while it's on. It starts off. (#340)

### Changed

* `Rounded tab bar` now puts a soft blue spot behind the tab you're on, a smaller pill inside the bar's own, so it's easier to see where you are. It moves with you when you switch tabs, Facebook's own press ripple still shows, and it goes away with the switch. (#383)
* **Tooling:** Changelog entries don't open with a "Facebook:" label anymore. Hushfacebook only patches Facebook, so it repeated itself on every line. The release scripts stopped adding or asking for it, and they drop it from any bullet that still has one when a release is cut.
* `Home header picture` leaves out a see-through border around your picture now, so a logo saved with empty space around it fills the header instead of looking tiny. A border you can see, like a white frame, stays. Your saved picture isn't changed. (#230)
* Live feed videos get the play and pause button from `Inline feed video controls` now. They still don't get the seek bar or the cast button, since a live stream has no end to jump around in and no file to hand over. (#239)
* Patching is faster. Most patches used to read through all of Facebook's code, one class after another, to find the few places they change. Hushfacebook now reads the app once, notes what each class uses, and sends each patch straight to the classes it needs. On Facebook 585 the patch step went from about 22 seconds to about 15 on a two-core run, and the patched app comes out the same as before. (#216)
* The Hush settings have a new look. The page opens on Hushfacebook's own blue H logo (it ships inside the patch, so it shows even when the launcher icon is left alone), the Hushfacebook name in a blue gradient and a line with the patch and Facebook versions, with the search and a new `Show all settings as a list` toggle under them. By category, each section is a full-width row you tap to open. As a list, every section shows at once, and the page remembers which way you picked. Open sections sit on inset cards under their headings, every row has an icon, and only rows that open something get an arrow. The bar at the top names the page again once the header scrolls away, and says Search settings while you type a search.
* Dialogs in the Hush settings match the page. Titles are in the gradient, and buttons are outlined cards at least 48 dp tall that wrap long words instead of cutting them off. A picked choice is tinted in the accent, and a text field's outline lights up while you type in it.
* When a change needs a restart, the restart button is now an outlined bar under the search, lined up with the cards. Restarting still brings you back to the same settings page, in the same view.
* Every text color in the Hush settings was measured and adjusted so it reads at 4.5:1 or better on the page, the cards and the dialogs. Section headings reach 7:1 on the black page.
* The Advanced Marketplace filters title and its help use the same gradient as the Hush settings. The ? next to the title is a rounded square now, and it's easier to hit.
* A long press on the title at the top of the other tabs opens the Hush settings too. Before, only the logo on Home did. (#374)
* With `Show when listings went up` on, a listing's date sits right under its price, where Facebook puts Just listed, so you don't have to scroll down to the place line for it. Cars and other vehicles keep Facebook's own Listed line. (#303)
* `Hide Up next on videos` also takes away the empty space Facebook kept for that bar, so the seek bar sits back at the bottom of the video. (#375)
* `See-through bars` now reaches the Marketplace tab. Marketplace's page used to stop right above the tab bar, so the bar had nothing behind it to show. With the switch on, the page now runs under the bar the way Home's feed does, and turning the switch off puts it back. (#250)
* `Turn off auto-translation` now covers comments too. With it on, a comment Facebook translated by itself shows in the words its writer used, and See translation under it still translates it when you tap. (#372)
* **Tooling:** `scripts/gen-l10n.py` writes each language's table to a class of its own, since the one generated file had grown past the size lint will read. The release check also stops counting Russian plural rows as missing from the other tables when their English runs over more than one line.
* **Tooling:** The source census leaves out GitLab forks that are waiting to be deleted. Someone keeps forking the GitLab sources and deleting the copies again within a few hours, so every census flagged forks that were already gone.
* With `Show full post text` on, a tap on a post's text folds it back to See more, and another tap opens it again, the way Facebook does it with the switch off. Before, a long post stayed open whatever you tapped. (#354)
* Opening a section in the Hush settings folds the one you had open, so the page stays short and only one section is open at a time. (#368)
* `Burn-in guard` now dims around a wide video you open from the feed. It plays small in the middle of the full-screen viewer, so the guard used to leave it alone. (#370)
* If a future Facebook moves one of the spots `Leave calls and chats to Messenger` hooks into, `Open Messenger from the top bar` still patches. Only the second switch drops out of the settings for that build. (#39)
* `Open feed videos on their own` now also holds group videos that Facebook opens as a regular video post, like one from an anonymous group member or a group video you open from your home feed. Swiping up from them used to reach the next video. (#237)
* `Hide suggested groups` takes the "Suggested for you" groups card off the Groups tab now, along with Home. (#347)
* `Hide the top right buttons on opened videos` takes Search and the profile button off the top of the Reels tab too. Menu stays where it is. (#346)
* `Hide affiliate product links` also keeps the shop banner (the one with "On Shopee" and an X) off a creator's profile when you open it from one of their reels. (#329)
* `Inline feed video controls` now puts its buttons on videos in Pages, groups and profiles, as well as on Home. (#239)
* `Search date range` now takes a day for each end too. Pick the months on Facebook's own wheels and the days on the two wheels under them, so a search can cover a few days instead of whole months. (#279)
* `Hide the Subscribe button on videos` also takes the Subscribe pill in a reel's footer, next to the author's name. (#291)
* `Hold a feed video for 2x` can stay at 2x now. Pull down before you let go, and tap the video when you want its old speed back. (#229)
* `Hide "Related posts" under posts` also takes the list of posts Facebook shows after the comments when you open a post on its own, and that post stops asking Facebook for the list. (#231)
* With `View stories anonymously` on, `Hide seen stories` also takes out a story you watched to the end on this phone. Facebook never hears about those views, so it kept calling them unseen and they stayed in the tray. The story comes back when that person posts a new one. (#218)

### Fixed

* With `Force dark mode` on, the Hushfacebook settings go dark along with Facebook. On a phone or tablet in light mode they stayed light, which stood out most on tablets where Facebook's own settings have no Dark mode. (#259)
* With `Default comment order` on All comments, a post whose comments open in Most relevant and get switched over no longer stops after the first ten or so with a spinner under them. The switch happened while Facebook was still loading the first batch, and that left the next page loading forever until you closed the comments and opened them again. It now waits a second for that first batch, the way a tap of your own would. (#384)
* With `Keep feed position on return` on, going back to the feed from a post's own page or its comments keeps your place on accounts where Facebook opens those as a screen of their own. Facebook checks whether to reload the feed each time it comes back into view, and those checks were only answered after you'd left the app, so Back from a post could still reload the feed and jump to the top. Pull to refresh still works. (#378)
* Most videos you open from the feed play in a second full-screen viewer, and it kept its own UP NEXT pill and a black strip under the video. `Hide Up next on videos` now hides that pill there too. The strip is the room Facebook keeps for the comment box, so with `Hide the video comment box` on it goes as well. The video fills the screen and its seek bar moves down to the bottom with it. That also stops the top of the next reel from peeking in under the video, in a profile's reels and in videos you open from the feed. (#375, #358)
* `Show full post text` opens long reel captions whole again on Facebook 585. (#268)
* `Burn-in guard` dims the eye that `View stories anonymously` puts on stories, along with the story's other buttons. It used to stay at full brightness.
* With the Material You theme, a color you pick in `Accent color` now reaches the plus on Create story and the Find friends button too. They kept the wallpaper's color before. (#272)
* With `Keep the progress bar` on, a reel opened from the feed shows its time bar right away. It used to be missing for a second or so while the reel viewer caught up with the video the feed had been playing. For that moment the bar now sits at the start, then jumps to where the reel is and keeps moving. (#359)
* With `Hide seen stories` and `View stories anonymously` both on, a story Facebook has shown as watched once now stays hidden until that person posts a new one, even after a restart or a refresh that sends it as unwatched. Before, it stayed hidden only when the time you watched it lined up with Facebook's post time, so a phone clock that's a bit off could bring it back. (#340)
* With `Turn off HDR brightness` on, HLG reels in VP9 shouldn't come out bright and yellow anymore on phones without a Snapdragon chip. The switch used to ask the phone's video decoder to convert those reels itself, and some phones' conversion shifted the colors. Now the reel goes over in its own colors and Android fits them to the screen, which is what Snapdragon phones already got. I've only watched it on a Snapdragon phone so far. (#93)
* With `Keep the progress bar` on, a playing reel no longer redraws the whole screen every frame. The bar moves about a pixel at a time and at most 30 times a second, and a long reel's bar moves only as often as Facebook's own does. On my phone the screen used to redraw about 55 times a second for as long as a reel played, and Pause showed none of that. `Fix washed-out video colors` now says it can make videos stutter, mostly high frame rate ones. (#364)
* `Hide For you in search` now also hides the For you grid when Facebook sends the search page without saying which section is which. That happens on the page Facebook loads ahead of time when the app starts, from Home or any other tab. In that case Hushfacebook reads the section's name from the page's own layout, and Debug logging lists the names it found. (#285)
* With `See-through bars` on, a feed video that slides under the top or bottom bar is blurred along with the rest of the page on phones where Facebook used to draw it on a separate layer the blur couldn't reach. Reels keep that layer. (#250)
* With `Open comments at full height` on, tapping more on a reel's description opens the whole text right there again. It used to open the comments instead, on reels Facebook would have shown with comments in a split screen. (#269)
* In a copy made with `Clone app`, the in-app browser asks the copy itself for the processes that draw its pages. It used to ask the regular Facebook app, which a copy can't count on being there. I haven't watched this on a signed-in copy yet. (#36)
* With `Burn-in guard` set to dim and shift, stories stay put. The story viewer is see-through, so each step showed a thin line of the feed at its edge. Stories still dim. (#369)
* `Show the post date on reels` now works on reels with a song. In the Reels tab the song's name takes the line under the poster, so most reels still had no date. The date now goes in front of the song, like "3 weeks ago · Artist · Song". (#357)
* When an imported file picks a start tab, the import message now says it applies with `Open on a chosen tab` on. It used to say Facebook will open there, even with that switch off.
* Importing a settings file that changes a lot of switches no longer freezes Facebook. A big file could hold the screen for about a minute, long enough for Android to offer to close the app. With something typed in the settings search it was worse, and settings that wait for a restart added a pause of their own.
* `See-through bars` keeps its blur lined up with the bar when the page under it is scrolled inside its own frame.
* With `Search date range` on, the Date posted row in Filter Posts keeps showing the range you applied instead of going back to Any date, and the range stays put when you change another filter. (#279)
* A profile you open from someone's story stays out of your search history's visits now, with either `Don't save search history` or `View stories anonymously` on. (#221)
* The play and cast buttons on feed videos now land in the same place on every phone, just under the channel picture on reel style posts. How far down they sat used to depend on the status bar.
* With the tab bar at the top, Notifications, Groups, Feeds and Profile no longer lose their first rows under the bar. 0.20.0 caused this when it let reels run full height under a top bar, and now only the Reels tab does that. (#328)
* Starting on a Feeds filter, like Friends, no longer lands on an empty "You're all caught up" page. The chosen filter now loads its posts by itself. (#330)
* `See-through bars` keeps frosting the tab bar when the page under it stops short of the bar's holder or sits a level up. Those layouts used to flip it to a dark strip with the feed sharp behind it. (#250)
* With `Tab to open on` set to Feeds on an account with no Feeds tab, `Restart Facebook to apply this change` lands back on the settings screen. The Feeds page used to open over it. (#330)
* `Select part of a post's text` no longer draws solid boxes behind the selection handles and the copy toolbar. (#294)
* With `Keep the progress bar` on, a reel's bar and time now travel with the reel while you drag it, so they stop sitting on top of the next reel. (#120)
* `Keep the progress bar` lifts a reel's bar when the Reels tab would put it behind the tab bar. (#282)
* A post a link opens stays at the top of Home even when Facebook sends it as an ad, which it does for a boosted page post. The ad switches used to hide it, and the suggested post after it showed in its place. (#306)
* With `Select part of a post's text` on, holding a post's text only opens the box now. It doesn't also copy the whole text, so whatever you had on the clipboard stays there, and Facebook's "Text copied to clipboard" message no longer pops up for it. The box has a Copy all button for when you do want all of it. (#342)

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark color you pick, instead of dark gray, which can save battery on OLED screens. Cards and menus stay a shade lighter than the page. Turn on Black cards in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance to make them black too, and Lines between posts there for a thin gray line between posts in the feed. Light background color there gives light mode a soft color in place of white. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

options.description: The color dark mode's backgrounds use, as a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #0D1117. Leave it blank for black. Cards and inputs get a slightly lighter shade. Grays up to about #535353 work, and lighter colors are refused so text stays readable.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Facebook's blue on links, buttons, switches and the selected tab for a color you like better. Nothing changes until you pick one. Pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and screen recordings on the pages where Facebook blocks them, so you can keep a copy of what's on screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Badge and logo colors
patches.description: Paints the count badges on the tabs, the Facebook logo at the top of Home and the selected tab in colors you pick. Nothing changes until you type a color. Set them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Block Instant Games ads
patches.description: Games you play inside Facebook show no ads, so you can keep playing without breaks. A rewarded ad gives no reward unless you also turn on the switch that counts it as watched. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu.

patches.name: Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install after seeing ads, and stops several of the ways it sends your phone's advertising ID, so less of what you do feeds its ad tracking. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops the jobs Facebook runs in the background to download ads, and the model it ranks them with, before you ever see them. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Facebook within ten minutes, or any time with No time limit on, so you don't lose what you were reading. A second switch, Back leaves Home where it is, stops Back on a scrolled Home from jumping to the top and reloading. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Block promotional notifications
patches.description: Blocks the kinds of notification you pick, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays, so you get fewer pings you don't care about. Messages, friend requests, comments and login alerts always come through. Starts off. Turn on the kinds you want in Hushfacebook settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Block screenshot detection
patches.description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats and everywhere else, so it can't react to it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Clean up Facebook's chat list
patches.description: Tidies Chats inside Facebook. One switch empties the row of notes and who's active above your chats, and another removes promotional banners like the one asking you to turn on notifications. A third takes the Meta AI button off the search row and the search screen. Your chats stay. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted. Its Burn-in guard can fade a reel's buttons, caption and bars when you leave them alone, so they don't burn into the screen. With Turn off HDR brightness patched too, it can show Reels in gray, video and all. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Clean up the story viewer
patches.description: Switches that take the song and effect credits and the Subscribe button off a story, and the suggested replies off the bottom while the reply box stays, plus one that adds a thin progress bar along the bottom like the one on Reels. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Comment sheet options
patches.description: Small fixes for comments. Stop a long press on Like from opening reactions, hide the GIF and sticker buttons, show every reply without tapping View replies, load a whole reply thread as you scroll, close an open reply thread with a Hide replies button, open more replies with a tap anywhere on their row, hide the comments under feed posts, hide the thumbs-down on comments or turn it into a Block button, put Block on reaction lists, hide Like on comments, hide Related groups under group posts, hide comments with shop links or your words, hide who is typing and the new comments pop-up, hide the emoji row over the comment box, hide the line over the comment box, and hide the comment box under full-screen videos. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Default comment order
patches.description: Opens comments in the order you choose, Most relevant, Newest, All comments or Oldest, instead of the one Facebook picks. Handy if you always want the newest first. Starts off. Turn it on and pick an order in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of what Facebook picks. Lower saves data, higher looks sharper. Starts off. Turn it on and pick a quality in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving its ads inside other apps on your phone. Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops Google Play offering Facebook updates, which a patched app can't take anyway. It isn't selected by default because once it's installed, a build without it can't install over it. It doesn't work on a Root Mount install. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Don't save search history
patches.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for, and the pages and profiles you open from a search, to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched, so it learns less about what you watch. Reels you've already seen may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Double tap to skip
patches.description: A double tap on the left or right edge of a reel or video skips back or forward 10 seconds, or 5 on one under 30 seconds. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Download any photo
patches.description: Shows Save photo on every photo you open, even where the poster turned saving off, and saves the largest size so you get the best copy. A GIF comment gets Save GIF when you long-press it. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel and a Download row to its More menu, so you can keep reels on your phone. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. The More menu also gets Copy caption, which copies the reel's whole caption. On by default. Turn either off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music, so you can keep the ones you like. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, so you can save them to watch later. A video comment gets Save video when you long-press it. Videos save at the quality you set, best by default. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Following feed on Home
patches.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says. Useful on tablets, where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Frame step
patches.description: With a reel or video paused, a tap on its right side steps one frame forward and a tap on its left side one frame back, so you can stop on the exact moment you want. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: For phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Facebook asks microG-RE for its push notifications, and microG-RE gets the signature of Meta's own Facebook for the Google services that check one. It isn't selected by default because Facebook then stops asking Google Play services, so a phone without microG-RE gets no push notifications. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Hide AI-detected posts
patches.description: Removes posts and reels Facebook marked as made with AI, posts creators labeled as AI, posts with Meta's AI characters and Meta AI cards in the feed. Only the Meta AI cards switch starts on. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed and Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide Menu promotions
patches.description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections and the Muse card in Facebook's Menu, so the Menu has fewer ads for Meta's products. Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. Switches there, off by default, also hide the Meta AI shortcut or the whole Help and support section and keep Settings and privacy open, and a list there hides the Menu tiles and Help and Settings rows you pick, such as Gaming or Orders and payments.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI comment summaries
patches.description: Removes Meta AI's summary of the comments from the top of the comment sheet and from under posts, so you read what people actually wrote. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI in search
patches.description: Removes the Meta AI answer and Ask Meta AI prompts from search results, and stops suggestions from sending your search to Meta AI. You get plain results for people, groups, Pages and posts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts
patches.description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts, for a cleaner feed. The post and its buttons stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide Meta upsells
patches.description: Hides Meta's pushes for its other products, such as Edits, Threads cross-posting, Meta Verified, avatar stickers and Meta AI's Imagine, so you see fewer sales pitches. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Meta's other products.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of reels between posts and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends, so the feed sticks to posts. A reel a friend posts stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide Stories tray
patches.description: Hides the row of stories at the top of the feed, the stories between posts, or the "What's on your mind?" row at the top of Home, so you reach posts sooner. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes the shopping cards that affiliate links add to reels, feed posts and comments, plus Shop now cards on reels and the shop banner on a profile you open from one, so you see fewer sales pitches while you scroll. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide carrier data banners
patches.description: On carriers with Facebook Flex, hides the Data mode bar with its buy mobile data button, or the purple Free mode bar, so the feed gets that space back. Both switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Hide post prompts
patches.description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or follow suggestions, so posts look less cluttered. No gap is left. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed. Four more switches there, Hide the Follow link on posts, Hide the Join button on posts, Hide counts on posts and Hide the reaction preview on posts, start off.

patches.name: Hide posts by words
patches.description: Hides feed posts with words you list, or from people, Pages or sites you list, so you skip topics you're tired of. Photo, video, link and colored background posts, every post a Page wrote, or posts in languages you don't read can go too. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide profile notes
patches.description: Hides the note bubble on profile pictures, the Drop a thought prompt on your own profile included. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: People you chat with in chats that open inside Facebook don't see that you've read their messages, so you can read now and reply later. Replying may still show you've read it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide reel interest prompts
patches.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt, so reels play without the interruption. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide seen posts
patches.description: Keeps posts you've already scrolled past out of the feed when it loads again, for 1, 3, 7, 30 or 90 days, so you see something new. The list stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
patches.description: Removes ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results, so you see more of what people are selling. Listings people post stay. It also reads rules typed into Marketplace search: "word" keeps titles with the word, -word hides titles with it and in:place keeps listings in that place, and an Adv. Filters button writes them for you. The search rules and the button are off until you turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind, so you see fewer ads. It also keeps the floating ad button off an ad's comments. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored profile posts
patches.description: Removes the ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page, so you only see what they posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over reels and ads in the middle of videos, so you can watch without interruptions. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide sponsored search results
patches.description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, so you see the people, Pages and posts you searched for. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories shows only what people posted. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide suggested and promoted posts
patches.description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads, like "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know" and suggested groups, so you see more from people you follow. Most of its switches are on by default. Change them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, and the "Find friends from contacts" card, so the Stories tray sticks to people you know. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Stories, where more switches, all off at first, also hide the Pages you follow and the stories you've already watched, or keep only the ones you've watched.

patches.name: Hide tab badges
patches.description: Takes the dot and count off the tabs you pick, and Facebook's count off its app icon, so the app nags you less. Notifications still arrive and still show in the Notifications tab. Starts off. Turn on the ones you want in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation.

patches.name: Hide tabs
patches.description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar, such as Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events, so the bar only has what you use, and puts the ones left in the order you want. Each page stays in the Menu. Starts off. Pick the tabs and their order in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Feeds header
patches.description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens straight on posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Get Messenger card
patches.description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats when Messenger is already installed. A patched Facebook may not see that Messenger is there, so it keeps showing the card. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, off the tab bar, so Reels isn't one tap away. Reels in your feed and reel links still open. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab dot
patches.description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts, so it stops calling for your attention. Other tabs keep theirs. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Others don't see that you're typing, in chats that open inside Facebook and in comment boxes, so you can write without anyone watching. Your messages send as usual. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hold a reel for 2x
patches.description: Hold a reel to play it at double speed, and let go to go back to normal. Handy for skimming. The reel's more button still opens Facebook's long-press menu. A second switch does the same for videos playing in the feed and in Watch, and a third keeps the plain 2x pill without Facebook's "Pull down to lock 2x speed" hint. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Hold back analytics uploads
patches.description: Stops Facebook sending its usage reports in the background and skips the learning jobs it runs on your phone, so less about how you use the app leaves it. A second switch holds back the camera roll processing that uploads your photos and details about them for sharing suggestions. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Privacy, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Home header text
patches.description: Shows your own words or picture at the top of Home instead of the Facebook logo. Words take Facebook's own colors for light and dark mode. Type them in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance > Home header text, or pick a picture under Home header picture. Blank keeps Facebook's logo.

patches.name: Hushfacebook in the Menu
patches.description: Adds a Hushfacebook settings row to Facebook's Menu, at the end of Settings and privacy, so the settings are easy to find. A Saved row joins it while the Saved shortcut switch is on, a Watch history row while the Watch history shortcut switch is, and a Free stuff row, Marketplace's free listings, while the Free stuff shortcut switch under Marketplace is. On by default. Turn it off with Settings row in Menu in Hushfacebook settings > Menu, unless it's the last way into the settings still on.

patches.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed, the title at the top of another tab, or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon, and Icon style can make the icon white on black or black on white. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

options.description: A name to show under the app icon, in App info and in recent apps instead of Facebook, up to 50 characters, so this copy is easy to tell apart. Leave it empty to keep Facebook's name. It only changes the name. Clone app is what lets a copy install next to the official Facebook.
Facebook colors keeps the home screen icon as it is. White on black and Black on white draw Facebook's "f" in one color on a plain icon. Themed icons on Android 13 and up still work.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace install next to your patched Facebook. Without it, Android refuses them because they share two permissions with Facebook. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep feed videos muted
patches.description: Feed videos start with the sound off every time you open Facebook, and only a tap on a video's speaker or the volume up key turns it on. It can also keep a long watch of a video you open from turning the feed's sound on. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep post dates
patches.description: Keeps the date under the poster's name, so you can always tell how old a post is. Facebook's newer header can swap it for rotating details, and on some phones the line goes blank. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Keep the progress bar
patches.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: A speed you pick in a reel's menu stays for the next reels, even after Facebook restarts, so you don't set it every time. Pick normal speed to go back. On by default. A second switch for feed and Watch videos starts off. Live videos that have ended get Playback speed in their gear menu too, also on by default. All of it is in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Local profile counts
patches.description: Shows friends, followers and following counts you type yourself on your own profile, on this phone only. Other profiles and Facebook's real numbers aren't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Longer music on photo stories
patches.description: A song you add to a photo for your Story plays for up to 30 seconds instead of 15. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Marketplace only
patches.description: Turns Facebook into a Marketplace app for buying and selling without the feed. The tab bar keeps only Marketplace, Notifications and your profile or Menu, and Facebook opens on Marketplace. The Events only switch does the same for Events once you pin Events in Facebook's Customize the bar. Both start off. Turn one on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Gives Facebook the colors of your wallpaper on Android 12 and newer, so it matches your phone. Dark mode takes them everywhere, and light mode on its grays, blues and selected tab. It isn't selected by default because undoing it means patching again. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Newest reels first
patches.description: Plays the newest posted of the reels Facebook has loaded for you first in the Reels tab, instead of Facebook's own pick. It can't fetch newer reels. A second switch lists a profile's Reels tab with its most viewed reels first. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger. Also carries Leave calls and chats to Messenger, a separate switch that starts off and leaves calls and chat notifications to Messenger while it's installed and enabled. Restart Facebook after changing the switch or whether Messenger is installed or enabled, so call routing updates.

patches.name: Open comments at full height
patches.description: Opens the comment sheet at the full height of the screen instead of part way up, on posts, videos, reels and stories. On reels and videos, Comment opens that sheet instead of the split view. A second switch pauses a reel while its comments are open, and a third lets a tap on the reel above a half-open sheet play or pause it. All start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Open comments with a gesture
patches.description: Open a reel's comments with a double tap or a long press, on the sheet the Comment button opens, instead of liking or holding, and a feed post's with a long press on its photo or name line. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch. It also lets a long press on a post's text open that text to select part of it, a switch in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Open in Facebook from the share menu
patches.description: Adds Open in Facebook to Android's share menu. Share a Facebook link or page to it from Messenger's browser or any other app, and it opens here instead of in that app. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your own browser instead of Facebook's built-in one, without Facebook tracking the click. Facebook pages still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing. A second switch, on by default under Privacy, stops Facebook's browser keeping a history of the links you open in it. A Page's Events link opens on that Page's Events tab instead of Home, whichever way the switches are set.

patches.name: Open on a chosen tab
patches.description: Opens Facebook on the tab you pick when you start it from its icon, so you can skip the feed. It's Marketplace unless you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches.name: Photo carousel
patches.description: Shows a post's photos and videos in a row you swipe through, one at a time with a 4/10 count and dots, instead of a grid. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps reels and videos from the Reels and Video tabs, or full screen, playing in a small window when you leave Facebook, so you can watch while using another app. Needs Android 12 or later. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom
patches.description: Pinch a story or a photo on someone's profile to zoom in, like you can on photos in the feed. It goes back when you let go, unless you turn on Stay zoomed under it, which keeps the zoom until you tap or press Back. Keep videos playing while zoomed, another switch under it, lets a video on a profile or Page play on while you zoom, and with Stay zoomed you press and hold to pause it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Post action buttons
patches.description: Adds Facebook's own Save button next to Like, Comment and Share under posts, and a Download button on posts with a video or photos that saves them the way the post's menu does. It can also take Like, Comment, Share or Send out of that row. Each has its own switch, and they all start off. Find them in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Remove the gap above Marketplace listings
patches.description: Takes out the empty band some phones show between the status bar and a Marketplace listing's close and share buttons, like Pixels on Android 17. Phones without the gap look the same as before. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Fixes profiles, photos, posts and some Settings pages that won't open on a patched Facebook, lets a Messenger or Facebook Lite patched in the same Manager sign in through it, and opens Instagram and Threads links in a patched Instagram or Threads. Root Mount installs don't need it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time it plays, in the feed or full screen, so you don't lose your place. Reels, live videos and ads start as usual. Remember what you watch, a second switch, keeps a list on your phone of the reels, videos and stories you watched, under Recently watched. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. It also lets Take breaks count reels for its Also after 20 reels switch.

patches.name: Round stories tray
patches.description: Draws the stories row on Home as round pictures at a size you pick, like Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Takes Facebook's tracking tags off links you share or copy, so you share a clean link. A facebook.com/share/ link is made for one share, so Facebook can still trace that kind back to you, and a switch that starts off shares the post's own link in its place. On by default. Both are in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing.

patches.name: Search date range
patches.description: Adds a from and to date picker to the Date posted filter in post search, in place of the list of years, so you can narrow results to a few days or a stretch of months. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: Search posts tab
patches.description: Puts the Posts chip back in the row over search results, after Reels, so you can see only posts for what you searched. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches.name: See who shared
patches.description: Adds See who shared to a post's menu, which opens Facebook's list of the people who shared it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Send chat photos and videos at original quality
patches.description: Photos and videos you send from chats that open inside Facebook go out as the originals instead of smaller copies, so they arrive sharp. Very large files are still shrunk. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches.name: Share sheet items
patches.description: Lets you hide items you never use from Facebook's share sheet, such as WhatsApp, Meta AI or Copy link, so the ones you want are easier to reach. Nothing is hidden until you pick. Choose them in Hushfacebook settings > Links and sharing, where two switches that start off also take away the buttons that send to the people you picked as a new group chat and the row of people Facebook suggests sending to.

patches.name: Show View profile on Marketplace sellers
patches.description: Adds View profile to every seller's Marketplace page. It opens their regular Facebook profile, so you can check who you're buying from. Facebook shows that button to only some accounts. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Marketplace.

patches.name: Show full post text
patches.description: Shows all of a post's text in the feed, and a reel's caption, so you don't have to tap See more. A tap on the text folds it back. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Skip silent parts
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and stories past the silent stretches in their sound, so talks and how-tos get to the point sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio. With Resume long videos patched too, a video's menu can keep the silent parts in that one video.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Facebook crashing or freezing at start on x86 devices, such as computer emulators and x86 Chromebooks. Most phones and tablets don't need it, and it doesn't change how they start. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe, so you can take your time with it. A second switch replays a finished story from the start. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop update prompts
patches.description: Stops Facebook asking you to update, since a patched app can't install Meta's updates anyway. Meta App Manager's update prompts and chat prompts aimed at older versions go too. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Updates.

patches.name: Story viewer taps
patches.description: A tap in the middle of a story shows a play and pause button, like Reels, and a second switch makes stories change only on a double tap, so a single tap pauses or plays instead. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. `Tab bar position` can also put it at the top, as older Facebook had it, or leave it where Facebook puts it. `Tab bar while scrolling` lets it slide away as you scroll or keeps it on screen, and another switch keeps the top bar on screen. One gives tablets and unfolded phones the phone layout so the bar can move there too, and one makes the top bar and the tab bar see-through. Another hides the phone's status bar on the main screen until you swipe down from the top. Three more take the Messenger button, its unread count or the Facebook logo out of the top bar. Starts off. Pick it in Hushfacebook settings > Tabs and navigation, then restart Facebook. The see-through and status bar switches sit under Appearance.

patches.name: Tag suggestions only after @
patches.description: Stops Facebook offering people to tag while you type ordinary words in posts and comments, so names don't pop up in your way. Typing @ still brings up the list. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Comments and writing.

patches.name: Tap shows the controls
patches.description: A tap on a playing reel shows its controls and lets it keep playing, so you can skip or mute without stopping it. The button in the middle still pauses. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Tap to play
patches.description: Videos, reels, stories and music wait for your tap instead of starting by themselves, so nothing plays until you want it to. A separate switch adds a play/pause button to feed videos. The switches start off in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Translate posts
patches.description: Translates posts in another language through Google Translate, from a Translate line under the post or by themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Turn off HDR brightness
patches.description: Stops HDR videos and photos from turning your screen up to full brightness, which can be harsh in the dark. They keep their resolution. A second switch fixes pale, washed-out reels on phones that show them that way. Its switches start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Video and audio.

patches.name: Turn off auto-translation
patches.description: Shows posts, comments and reel captions in the language they were written in, instead of Facebook's automatic translation, so you read people's own words. See translation still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > News feed.

patches.name: Turn off double tap to like
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a reel, a video or a photo in the feed from liking it, so you don't like things by accident. A single tap still plays, pauses or opens the photo, and the Like button still works. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches.name: Turn off haptics
patches.description: Stops the short vibrations Facebook plays when you tap and swipe in it, if you find them distracting. Your keyboard and your phone's own vibrations stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Turn off screen transitions
patches.description: Shows Facebook's tabs, Menu, photos and new screens at once, without the slide or zoom between them, so the app feels quicker. Swipes and animations inside a page stay. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches.name: Upload Stories in HD
patches.description: Videos you post to your Story ask Facebook for its high upload quality instead of standard, so they can come out sharper. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

patches.name: Use the phone's emoji
patches.description: Draws emoji with your phone's own emoji font instead of Meta's, so emoji in posts, comments and chats match your keyboard. Reactions and stickers stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: Use the system font
patches.description: Draws Facebook's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a font file you pick, so Facebook matches the rest of your phone. Icons and emoji keep their own. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of stories you watch, because Facebook isn't told which ones you've seen. Replying or reacting still shows you. Stories you watch to the end show as watched on this phone only, until that person posts a new one. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Stories.

release_notes:
This one stays on Facebook 585.0.0.47.54 and Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer, so just update the patches and repatch. The Hush settings got a new look with a `Switches that are on` list and a Custom accent color. New switches put a post's photos in a carousel, turn Reels gray, start a break after 20 reels, translate or hide posts in other languages, and add a seek bar and a full player button to feed videos. Stories can get a play button and a progress bar along the bottom. There are plenty of fixes too, like comments that stopped loading after the first ten and Back from a post jumping the feed to the top.

New in this release

- New `Open full screen videos centered` under Video and audio. A video you open in Facebook's full screen player, from a comment or a link, starts with its details and comments folded away, so a wide video sits in the middle of the screen instead of up at the top. The arrow under it still opens the panel. It's off by default. (#242)

- New `Dim around a zoom` under `Pinch to zoom`. Turn it off and the rest of the screen stays as it is while you zoom into a photo or story, instead of going dark behind it. It's on by default, so zooms look the same as before until you change it. (#220)

- New `Keep videos playing while zoomed` under `Pinch to zoom`. A video you zoom into on a profile or Page keeps playing under your fingers, where it used to stop on the frame it showed. With `Stay zoomed` on too, press and hold the zoom to pause the video and hold again to play it. Stories still hold still while you zoom. It's off by default. (#220)

- New `Search photo in post menus`, right under `Save photo in post menus`. A post with one photo gets Search photo in its three-dot menu, and a tap hands that photo to the app you pick, like Google Lens, so you can find out what's in it or copy the text out of it. The photo comes from Facebook's servers at the biggest size the post has, and only the app you pick can read it. It's off by default and needs `Save any photo` on. (#245, #248)

- New `Show Reels in gray` under Reels and Watch, with the other `Clean up Reels` switches. The Reels screen shows in black and white, buttons, caption and video alike, which makes it a little easier to put down. Your feed, stories, photos and chats keep their colors, and so does a reel you download. A video you open full screen from the feed can go gray too, since it plays on a screen like Reels. A swipe between reels doesn't flash color, and the colors come back when you leave Reels. It starts from the next reel after you turn it on, because the reel's player has to draw with the rest of the screen for its video to go gray, so this needs the `Turn off HDR brightness` patch in your build too. It's off by default and costs a little battery on Reels.

- New `Also after 20 reels` under `Take breaks`. With it on, a break also starts once you've watched 20 different reels, if that comes before your `Break after` time. A reel counts after it's played for 3 seconds, so ones you swipe past right away don't, and watching the same reel again doesn't count twice. Ads and live videos never count. The count starts over after a break, after time away as long as a break, and when the switch is turned off, and it survives a restart of Facebook. It's off by default and needs the `Resume long videos` patch, which is what notices reels playing. (#248)

- New `Full player button on feed videos` under Video and audio, right below `Inline feed video controls`. It puts a button next to play that opens the video in Facebook's own full player with all its controls, and a video playing in the feed stops first. Live videos get it too. It starts off, and with Tap to play on it needs `Inline feed video controls` on as well. (#239)

- New `Clean up the story viewer` under Stories, with three switches. `Hide song and effect credits` takes the song or effect credit off the line under the poster's name. A line that only showed the credit goes away, and one that switched back and forth keeps just its usual text. A story Facebook labels Trending or Suggested keeps its line as it was, so the label isn't lost. `Hide reply suggestions` takes away the row of suggested replies at the bottom of a story, and the reply box stays. `Progress bar at the bottom` draws a thin bar along the bottom of a story that fills as it plays, like the one on Reels. All three start off, and the first two apply from the next story you open. (#380)

- New `Story viewer taps` under Stories, with two switches. `Story play button` puts a play and pause button on a story when you tap its middle, the way Reels does. It fades away a couple of seconds after the story plays again, and taps on the sides still change stories. `Double tap for next story` makes stories change only on a double tap (the left side goes back, anywhere else goes forward), so a single tap pauses or plays the story instead, or brings up the button when that's on. The pause is Facebook's own. Both start off. (#380)

- New `Block button on reaction lists` under Comments and writing, next to `Block button on comments`. In the list of people who reacted to a post, the button at the end of each row (Add friend, Message, Confirm and the like) says Block, and a tap opens Facebook's own block screen for that person, with its usual question before anything is blocked. Your own row and rows Facebook shows no button on stay as they are. It's off by default, and a change shows on lists opened after it. (#271)

- New `GmsCore support` patch for phones without Google Play services, so Facebook gets its push notifications through microG-RE. It's off by default and only shows in Expert mode, since on a phone with Google Play services Facebook would stop getting push.

- New `Open in Facebook from the share menu` patch. Messenger keeps facebook.com links in its own browser, so share the page from there (or the link from any app) and pick Open in Facebook, and it opens in the patched Facebook. Hushfacebook settings lists it under Built-in changes, with a line on how to use it. (#111)

- New `Let each post come back once` under `Hide posts you've already seen`. A post counts as seen after a quarter second on screen, so a quick scroll used to hide plenty you never read. With this on, a post you scrolled past shows up one more time, and it's hidden once you scroll past it again. It starts off. (#186)

- Hushfacebook now tells you when Facebook's icons look soft because of the download you patched. The 32-bit bundle only has images for 320 dpi screens, so on a sharper screen the Home, bell, Profile, Search and Messenger icons get enlarged and look blurry. On a phone that can run the 64-bit bundle, a short note says so once after you install, and a line under the status card in the settings names the bundle to patch instead. (#365)

- New `Hide Up next on videos` under Reels and Watch. It takes the UP NEXT bar, with the next video's name and length, off the bottom of a video you open from the feed. Off by default. (#367)

- `Show the post date on reels` now dates older reels too. Past the first week Facebook often leaves the date out, so an older reel showed nothing under the poster's name even with the switch on. It now reads "3 weeks ago" there. A new `Show the post date as` list right under it picks between how long ago and the date it was posted, like Oct 12. (#357)

- New `Hide pictures on the Blocked list` under Privacy. The people on Facebook's Blocking page, in Settings & privacy, show without their profile pictures, and their names and Unblock buttons stay put. Every build has it, and it starts off. (#361)

- New `Videos in search results wait for a tap` under Video and audio. Videos in search results stay still until you tap one, whether `Tap to play` is on or off. It's off until you turn it on. (#363)

- New `Hide the Reels title` under Reels and Watch. It takes the word Reels off the top of the Reels tab and leaves the buttons beside it. It starts off. (#362)
